name: Plague Priest
theme: Apotheosis of the Pandemic specialist. Poison reservoirs swell, Plague Aura sears the encounter, every death seeds the next outbreak.
designNotes: Capstone effect mirrors §10.1: 'Poison stack cap +15. Pandemic spreads DoTs to 2 targets on death instead of 1.'
Pairs with the witchdoctor.json plague_priest path — same id, mirrors the path-7 capstone Pandemic Plus + amplifies further.
8-node compact tree, 3 tiers, ~14 total ranks (most multi-rank). Tier-3 capstone gates on Tier-2 progress (`requiresNodeId`).

Engine wiring status (2026-05-05): chaos-damage stat-stick + hex-conditional damageMult are wired today via TalentEffect dispatcher. Pandemic-mechanic + plague-aura nodes are decorative until Phase F engine wiring lands the matching event hooks.

nodes.name: Apothecary's Reservoir
nodes.description: Maximum poison stacks +1/2/3/4/5 (foundation reservoir for the capstone +15).

nodes.name: Pandemic Tempo
nodes.description: Each chaos DoT tick has +2/4/6% chance to refresh Plagued duration to full on the affected target.

nodes.name: Diffuse Mastery
nodes.description: Pandemic transfers permanently affect +1 enemy (stacks with Maximum Spread for total +2 before capstone).

nodes.name: Plague Bearer's Mark
nodes.description: Hexed enemies take +2/4/6/8/10% additional damage from your skills (additive vs class-tree Brand of Suffering).

nodes.name: Endemic Pulse
nodes.description: Plague Aura damage +25/50/75% (specifically scales the wd_pp_plague_aura class-tree node).

nodes.name: Festering Aftermath
nodes.description: On killing a Plagued enemy, +20/40/60% chance for the next chaos DoT tick on a different enemy in encounter to deal +200% damage.

nodes.name: Plague Sovereign
nodes.description: Maximum poison stacks +15. Pandemic spreads chaos DoTs to 2 enemies on death instead of 1 (stacks with Diffuse Mastery + Maximum Spread). The §10.1 ascendancy keystone.
